title: Sugarcane prices satisfactory for farmers: Haryana agri minister

ai.summary: Haryana's agriculture minister stated that the government's sugarcane state advised price (SAP) of ₹430-450 is satisfactory, but farmers have been protesting at sugar mills demanding ₹600 SAP and have stopped supplying the crop for crushing.

facts.claim: Haryana's agriculture minister stated that the government's sugarcane state advised price (SAP) of ₹430-450 is satisfactory
facts.quote: Chief minister Nayab Singh Saini has given ₹430 and ₹450 for next season, which is satisfactory. Even if the farmers demand more, this is their right. If Punjab is giving ₹1 extra, this is due to the elections

facts.claim: Farmers have been protesting at sugar mills across the state, demanding ₹600 SAP and have stopped supplying the crop for crushing at the mills
facts.quote: Farmers have been protesting at sugar mills across the state, demanding ₹600 SAP and have stopped supplying the crop for crushing at the mills

ai.background_note: Haryana farmers are protesting over sugarcane prices, demanding ₹600 SAP while the government has set ₹430-450 for next season.
